# MB AI Group

> MB AI Group (MBAI Solutions) is an AI product studio based in Cairo, Egypt and
> Dubai, UAE, founded by Mohanad Barakat, a former xAI Human Data Lead. The group
> builds AI agents, data systems, and products for MENA businesses, and ships its
> own ventures using the same underlying discipline (LLM alignment, RLHF,
> Arabic/Franco-Arabic NLP).

## Ventures

- [AutoLeadss](https://autoleadss.com): Done-for-you growth for local businesses:
  membership systems (subscription storefront, QR passes, staff redemption, owner
  dashboard), website design and rebuilds, ads management, and AI-assisted lead
  generation. Example work: Lash Cartel live client e-commerce store, with Stripe checkout
  and referral links/codes (https://www.lashcartelcosmetics.com).
- [TUT](https://tutapp.co): Live AI travel guide for Egypt. RAG / hyper-context
  from a sourced Egypt knowledge file; every answer names its source page and
  the day it was checked, or says nobody publishes one. Traveller signup is a
  free, shareable Egypt Pass boarding-pass souvenir: name in hieroglyphs,
  Pharaoh Me portrait as Tut or Cleopatra, stub number. Twelve languages
  (including Egyptian Arabic and Franco), dark/light themes, PWA install,
  itineraries / trips & plans library, practical info and verified local prices.
  Free for travellers; no subscriptions or paid passes. Free listing for vetted
  tour operators, guides, hotels, lodges, dive centres and transport. Revenue
  share only when TUT brings a booking; partner bookings go live with pilots.
  GEM & attraction tickets are planned, not live. Also on the way: licensed
  guides, stays, group trips & shared events, museum maps and browser voice mode.
  Guide: https://tutapp.co/guide; Pharaoh Me: https://tutapp.co/pharaoh;
  Check in: https://tutapp.co/checkin; business partner applications:
  https://www.tutapp.co/partners (plain business form, not traveller check-in).
  Page on this site: [/tut](/tut).
  Recognition: TUT has been shortlisted to pitch at the Global Entrepreneurship
  Festival (GEF), EIP programme 2026. Selected to pitch at GEF, 6–8 November 2026,
  JW Marriott New Cairo. This is not a claim of winning or funding.
  Traction, as of early November 2026: 9 partners interested; 5 asked for a
  pilot. Interest and pilot requests only; none signed yet. Source: GEF pitch
  TUT-Pitch-EIP-GEF-2026-v12, partner email replies logged to 4 Nov 2026.
- [IBNI](https://ibni-v2.vercel.app): AI app builder. Describe an app in Masri,
  Franco or English; it plans, codes, tests and publishes it. Preview. Page: [/ibni](/ibni).
- [Virlo Studio](https://virlo-studio.vercel.app): Egyptian-first AI video and
  image studio (Masri/Franco prompts, Egyptian templates, EGP pricing). Preview.
  Page: [/virlo](/virlo).
- [Be3ly](/be3ly): Prototype Egyptian affiliate / social-selling connector.
  Still building, no public product URL.

## Other interactive demos on this site

The [demos section](/#demos) also hosts self-contained interactive
demonstrations built by the same team, exploring adjacent problems: an ATS
resume optimizer, a Fear & Greed market-sentiment dashboard, a Franco-Arabic
translator (3araby), a local-intelligence tool for Egypt (Masr Guide), a
neobank UI, and an AI music-theory/practice tool (Sonic Boom). These are
demonstrations of engineering range, not separately incorporated ventures.

## Client work and open source

- ApexOne Knowledge Assistant: CPU-only, evidence-grounded knowledge assistant
  built for a hiring assessment (https://github.com/mohanadbarakattt/apexone-knowledge-assistant).
- Claude HQ: open-source mission control for Claude Code (https://github.com/mohanadbarakattt/claude-hq).
- Grok HQ: open-source mission control for Grok / xAI (https://github.com/mohanadbarakattt/grok-hq).
